peircean_analysis.firstness: Three artifacts, all from manual_forensic_review. A01: Brother claims real-time notification via screenshots; cannot produce device; does not know defendant's phone number; defendant has had him actively blocked for years; download quantity declared=null. A02: Panic button activated claiming defendant's physical presence; police record with timestamp, GPS, dispatched unit — independently verifiable. Claimed outcome: defendant fled. A03: Precision asymmetry — brother (primary, most active downloader) declares null quantity; peripheral Testigo-A from KIWI-006 declares exactly 10GB. Inverse precision pattern.
peircean_analysis.secondness: Three structural anomalies against the baseline of honest testimony: (A) A01 technical impossibility — a blocked contact cannot view the blocking party's content or receive communications in real time. The claimed surveillance mechanism is not a misremembering; it is physically impossible given the block status, which is stated as active and of long standing ('for years'). (B) A03 inverse precision — Grice's Quantity maxim requires speakers to provide information they possess. The brother, as the primary downloader, should know the quantity better than any peripheral associate. The reversal (peripheral knows 10GB exactly; primary actor knows nothing) is not explicable by honest uncertainty — it indicates active concealment by the party with most information. (C) A02 is structurally distinct from A01 and A03: the panic button activation has a verifiable external record (police dispatch logs). The activation itself is not in question; whether defendant was actually present at the claimed time and location is the unverified element.
peircean_analysis.thirdness: A01 + A03 together constitute a coherent pattern of testimony management: the brother conceals his download quantity (Grice Quantity) while claiming a surveillance method that cannot have functioned (Grice Quality). The peripheral witness's knowledge of the exact quantity (10GB) reveals the figure is known to the social network — the brother is not ignorant of it, he is actively suppressing it. A02 is epistemically orthogonal: it is the only artifact in this case with an independent verification path. If police records confirm defendant's location at the claimed time, A02 becomes confirmatory; if they contradict, A02 becomes a false report finding. Current status: unverified.

findings.title: Brother's Testimony — Technical Impossibility and Active Quantity Concealment
findings.firstness: Brother claims real-time monitoring via blocked channel; declares null download quantity while peripheral associate knows 10GB exactly.
findings.secondness: Active block renders claimed channel impossible. Inverse precision pattern violates Grice Quantity — primary actor knows least about his own activity.
findings.thirdness: Active concealment of download quantity combined with fabricated surveillance narrative. Two corroborating anomalies on same witness.
findings.carnegie: Carnegie Scarcity — creates urgency claims (real-time monitoring, danger) without verifiable supporting evidence.
findings.devil_advocate: Memory failures under stress. The block could have been temporarily lifted. Quantity omission could be embarrassment.
findings.corroboration: A03 independently confirms the quantity is known to the network (peripheral knows 10GB) — brother's null declaration is concealment, not ignorance.

hypotheses.H1_honest_recall: Brother genuinely monitored defendant via some other channel; panic occurred when confronted with block status; forgot quantity under stress.
hypotheses.H2_testimony_management: Brother deliberately conceals download quantity and fabricates impossible surveillance claim to avoid disclosing monitoring behavior while attributing harmful conduct to defendant.

refutation_protocol.benign_hypothesis: H1: Stress and poor memory could explain phone production failure and number ignorance. The block could have been lifted and re-applied, creating a window of access.
refutation_protocol.test_result: H1 PARTIALLY REFUTED: (A) Not knowing one's own phone number is unusual and not explained by stress — routine device ownership involves familiarity with the number. (B) The inverse precision pattern (peripheral knows 10GB; primary actor knows nothing) requires that the quantity was discussed within the network — the brother knows it and is concealing it, not forgetting it. (C) The block is stated as current and of long standing ('for years') — an occasional lift-and-reapply would require evidence the block was ever removed.
refutation_protocol.refutation_outcome: H1 partially refuted. H2 consistent with all observed anomalies. SUSPICION maintained.

devil_advocate: The brother's quantity omission could be embarrassment rather than strategic deception. The panic button activation (A02) is a verifiable act — it is not fabricated even if the cause could be disputed. The block status is stated but not forensically confirmed in this artifact set. Counter: the convergence of three anomalies (technical impossibility, quantity concealment, evidence withholding) on one witness strains the incompetence or embarrassment explanation.
